verdicts.reason: A is a broken layout. The headline, URL and brand name are missing entirely. The blue panel is an empty slanted shape. The white device-outline logo sits on the white background, where it is nearly invisible. The phone photo is cut down to a tiny strip, and the elements are scattered with huge dead areas around them. B is just the original banner shrunk into a thin strip in the middle of the tall canvas, so the headline and URL are far too small to read and roughly 90% of the canvas is empty white. It keeps the design's colours and arrangement, but it was not reworked at all for the vertical format. B is less bad only because the brand and message still survive, even though they can't be read at this size.
